summary: Adds revision-aware latest-upstream upgrades with an optional end-to-end verification pipeline.

Expands the manifest and runtime for launch-conflict detection, backup commands, coding-agent diagnostics, durability reporting, and toolchain preflight without requiring a project manifest migration.
Keeps JSON stdout machine-clean and reuses one verified Swift build per framework revision.
Distinguishes uncommitted upgrade changes, newly added files, and missing framework files in Doctor.
Treats fixed application ports as stable browser origins.
Adds opt-in Vite frontend pause/resume through View → Pause Live Updates; requires the bundled Vite adapter, a liveUpdates manifest declaration, and a launcher rebuild.
